audience: marketers and small businesses who send email newsletters with Cyberimpact

useCases.title: Compare the results of your recent mailings
useCases.text: The AI lists sent mailings and reads each one's delivery, view and click rates and per-link clicks. You see which mailings did best.

useCases.title: Find hard-bounced and unsubscribed addresses
useCases.text: The AI lists members whose last mailing hard-bounced, with the bounce date, and members who unsubscribed. You get a clean-up list.

useCases.title: See your groups and who is in them
useCases.text: The AI lists groups with member and mailing counts, and lists the members of one group.

useCases.title: Check one member's groups, mailings and consent
useCases.text: The AI reads a member by email: attributes, groups, mailings received, opened and clicked, and the consent record with type and date.

useCases.title: Add or update members and their groups, or send opt-ins
useCases.text: The AI adds a member who gave consent, or sends an opt-in email so the person joins a group after confirming. It can also update a member or add one to more groups.

useCases.title: Schedule a mailing to chosen groups
useCases.text: The AI checks the groups and templates, then schedules a mailing for a send time. It goes to every member of the chosen groups unless you cancel it in the app.
